thread:
jules: Quick heads-up: intermittent out-of-order chunks in browser SDK streaming when throttled. final chunk sometimes arrives before middle pieces. no error shown. :confused:
ria: is this EventSource or fetch+streams? any quick logs?
jules: EventSource in sampleapp. tiny log: [12:00:01] seq=1 "Hi"; [12:00:04] seq=4 "!"; [12:00:07] seq=2 ", folks"; [12:00:08] seq=3 " thanks". no reconnect shown in devtools.
sam: could be proxy H2 frame split + token refresh overlap. runtime may replay buffered fragments while old ones trickle. do you see any auth refresh around then?
jules: yes we had an auth refresh at 12:00:03 in network logs.
ria: quick mitigation: disable auto-reconnect in SDK or increase reconnect delay. long-term: runtime should emit a monotonic seq (SSE id or X-Chunk-Seq) and SDK add reorder/dedupe option. also emit a small telemetry counter when OOO detected.
infra-bot: created infra ticket #6201 "streaming: add chunk-seq + session id; recommend SDK reorder option" https://git.redwood/infra/issues/6201 :robot_face:
devx-bot: created SDK task #2407 "browser-sdk: opt-in reorderOnSeq flag + ooo telemetry" https://git.redwood/sdk/issues/2407 :robot_face:
jules: i'll add a minimal repro in sampleapp using nghttp2 to force frame splits and post it here. thanks! :thumbsup:
